findings.evidence: src/lib/auth.ts line 38 in the session callback is `session.user.id = token.sub;` - an assignment/write to session.user.id, not a read of it. Only src/lib/requireUser.ts line 6 (`const userId = session?.user?.id;`) actually reads the property.
findings.locationHint: | types | `src/lib/auth.ts` and `src/lib/requireUser.ts` both read `session.user.id`, which is only valid TypeScript because of the `Session` augmentation declared in `src/types/next-auth.d.ts`. |
findings.message: Doc states both auth.ts and requireUser.ts 'read' session.user.id, but auth.ts's session callback writes/assigns to session.user.id (`session.user.id = token.sub`) rather than reading it; only requireUser.ts reads it.
